This '''decoy vessel''' of the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] was utilized around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The decoy was equipped with a [[beacon transmitter]] that was encoded with the ''Slave I''{{'s}} identification. An empty shell that was constructed of a flimsy material, it was described by [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] as lacking any mass. He and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] boarded this vessel after the latter attempted to destroy it, under the impression that it was the real ''Slave I''.
